response.overview: Does going to the movies mean lights out, quiet, and sitting still? Not at the Disney Channel Interactive Cinema! Here, children can sing along, dance, clap, and solve riddles for an entire hour – anything but being quiet! On the big screen, Mickey Mouse, as the animated host of the 2026 Cinema Festival, guides moviegoers through the colorful program, designed for the youngest viewers of preschool age, offering approximately 65 minutes of child-friendly, interactive cinema. Tickets are only €5!
response.title: Disney Channel Mitmachkino (2026) September
